snippet.title: Final Dream - Developer Walkthrough
snippet.description:
You can download Final Dream for Windows from here :

http://sourceforge.net/projects/final-dream/

and LIKE us on facebook : http://www.facebook.com/relativegames

This game is a project I did 10 years ago when I wanted to make a basic 3D RPG kind of like Final Fantasy. I had almost no programming, modelling or audio skills but I have tried to make something that just works in this little game/demo. It features 7 levels, a couple of monsters, 2 spells, 1 summon and a few other tricks ;).

It also has a very neat ending. It's so over the top I might just make another video with it :).

PS: I'm also thinking to port the game for mobile devices. If you want to see it on your phone/tablet, like and rate the video and spread the word, I might just do it :)
